title: Laya-IsoToken: Day-One Clinical Codebook Switching via Closed-Form Operator Compilation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Healthcare systems periodically revise diagnostic and procedural classifications (ICD-9 to ICD-10/11), update hospital reimbursement groupers (MS-DRG), and deploy clinical coding across languages. Supervised coding networks bind clinical text encoders to fixed per-code classifier weights, forcing hospitals to re-annotate tens of thousands of records before switching codebooks, whereas standalone large language models incur high latency and hallucinate invalid codes. Here we show that day-one clinical codebook switching becomes feasible without target-labeled notes when local clinical evidence reading is decoupled from a strictly frozen multilingual concept space. Laya-IsoToken trains a clinical span reader once on source records with zero per-code classifier parameters, separating text evidence from historical disease prevalence. translated_title: Laya-IsoToken：通过闭式算子编译实现临床编码本的首日切换
translated_abstract: 医疗系统会定期修订诊断和操作分类（如从ICD-9到ICD-10/11），更新医院报销分组器（MS-DRG），并需要跨语言部署临床编码。监督式编码网络将临床文本编码器绑定到固定的逐码分类器权重上，迫使医院在切换编码本之前重新标注数万条记录；而独立使用的大型语言模型则存在高延迟问题，且会产生无效编码的幻觉。本研究表明，当局部临床证据读取与严格冻结的多语言概念空间解耦时，无需目标编码本标注的病历即可实现临床编码本的首日切换。Laya-IsoToken在源记录上仅训练一次临床片段读取器，不含任何逐码分类器参数，从而将文本证据与历史疾病流行率分离。仅需公开的目标编码描述，闭式矩阵编译即可对齐分布偏移（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出Laya-IsoToken方法，通过将临床证据读取器与冻结的多语言概念空间解耦，并利用闭式矩阵编译对齐目标编码描述，实现了在无需任何目标编码本标注病历的情况下首日完成临床编码本切换。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Laya-IsoToken, which achieves day-one clinical codebook switching without any target-labeled notes by decoupling the clinical span reader from a frozen multilingual concept space and using closed-form matrix compilation to align with target code descriptions.
